scatters.behavior: 3 or more bonus symbols trigger the free drops bonus game.

multipliers.name: Global Multiplier
multipliers.behavior:
the global multiplier.
The global multiplier multiplies every win with its value.
The long straw collects matching payout symbols not connected to the top
row.

collectors.name: Collector
collectors.behavior:
starts with one collector in view and collects all matching payout
symbols with a cleared path to the top row. If a win has occurred and no
more winning symbols have a cleared path to the top row,a new collector is
added to the game. The grid refills. The new collector collects matching
payout symbols with a cleared path to the top row.

specials.name: Coin
specials.behavior:
The Coin symbol pays its value times the selected bet level when it has a
clear path to the top row.

base_game_loop.summary: Slurpy: paid spin on 5x5 (expands to 7 rows). Collector Wins. Bonus modes: Bonus, Super Bonus. Round ends on win cap if reached.

phases.name: Place bet and spin
phases.what_happens: Player selects bet and hits Spin (or Auto Spin). Optional: activate an X-iter mode from base game only before the drop/spin.
phases.state_changes: Bet locked; optional X-iter mode selected

phases.name: Initial symbol drop/spin
phases.what_happens: Symbols land on 5x5 (expands to 7 rows). Game-specific setup features may fire (birds, Nitro/COOL reels, collectors, etc.).
phases.ends_when: All symbols at resting positions / reels stopped

phases.name: End-of-drop features
phases.what_happens: Resolve end-of-round features (bombs, mystery reveals, row swaps, boosters, etc.) if nothing else can happen; may resume avalanches.

phases.name: Bonus trigger check
phases.what_happens: If bonus/super-bonus trigger conditions met, enter bonus mode after resolving same-drop features. Otherwise settle base-game wins subject to win cap.
phases.state_changes: Enter bonus mode or settle base round

X-iter rules
The X-iter feature offers buy-in to different game modes.

SUPER BONUS:
Buy a game round triggering the bonus game, with 3 collectors and 7x7 grid.
Cost is 500x the selected bet.

BONUS:
Buy a game round triggering the bonus game. Cost is 100x the selected bet.

COIN DROP:
Buy a game round with guaranteed Coins on the grid. Cost is 25x the
selected bet.

EXTRA COLLECTOR:
Buy a game round with 3 collectors. Cost is 10x the selected bet.

BONUS HUNT:
Buy a game round with more than triple the chance to trigger the bonus
game. Cost is 3x the selected bet.

 Spin button.
